resources.string: Keeps the 3D scene at full size: sharper, more GPU work. Best with Resolution › Quality
Twice the game\'s starting graphics memory. Max resolution needs it
Game logic follows real time, so speed holds when fps changes. Does not raise fps

Fixes walls and rocks that vanish on Death Mountain Trail with Qualcomm\'s driver. Cheap in the cave, but about 7 fps slower in the castle: switch it on in the in-game panel there and off elsewhere. No effect on Turnip
Tells the game it is online so events that need a connection, such as Apples to Applin, can start. Nothing is sent. Experimental
